E5lebaDUd25Vm3VP-UgnFQ.zh: WHO報告指出,非洲流腦帶(African Meningitis Belt),從塞內加爾延伸至衣索比亞等26國,去年計有24國累計報告21,526例疑病例、971例死亡(致死率:4.5%),病例較前年下降5.9%。目前正推動5價疫苗(Men5CV/MMCV),其中日(Niger)已於去年展開全國性疫苗接種活動。
E5lebaDUd25Vm3VP-UgnFQ.en: WHO reports that the African Meningitis Belt, which extends from Senegal to Ethiopia across 26 countries, recorded 21,526 suspected cases and 971 deaths (case fatality rate 4.5%) in 24 countries last year, with cases down 5.9% from the previous year. The pentavalent meningococcal vaccine (Men5CV/MMCV) is being promoted, and Niger launched a nationwide vaccination campaign last year.

j_x2zPRkh8cOf741DvK8rA.zh: 塞內加爾疫情持續,今年截至9/8累計報告57例確定病例,其中8例死亡(致死率:14%),分布於8(/14)個行政區,並以凱杜古區(Kédougou Region)27例為多,當局呼籲家⻑應確認孩童接種情形,並依免疫接種規劃期程進行疫苗接種,且於出現症狀時即時就醫。 奈及利亞今年截至9/12已累計超過1萬例病例,98%確定病例分佈於8個州,其中68%確定病例未接種疫苗,推估持續的免疫缺口,導致疫情持續不斷。另高原州(Plateau State)疫情擴大,今年8/24-30報告48例確定病例,其中4例死亡,9/7起暫時關閉所有中/小學校,以降低傳播風險,並加強疾病監測、接觸者追蹤及疫苗接種等防治措施。
j_x2zPRkh8cOf741DvK8rA.en: Diphtheria in Senegal continues. As of 8 September this year, 57 confirmed cases have been cumulatively reported, 8 of whom died (case fatality rate 14%), spread across 8 of 14 districts, with 27 cases in Kédougou Region. Authorities urge parents to check children's vaccination status, to vaccinate according to the immunisation schedule, and to seek medical care promptly when symptoms appear. In Nigeria, more than 10,000 cases have been cumulatively reported this year as of 12 September; 98% of confirmed cases are distributed across 8 states, and 68% of confirmed cases were unvaccinated, indicating persistent immunity gaps that keep the outbreak going. The outbreak has also expanded in Plateau State, which reported 48 confirmed cases during 24–30 August this year, 4 of them fatal; from 7 September, all primary and secondary schools were temporarily closed to reduce the risk of transmission, and surveillance, contact tracing and vaccination are being strengthened.

KDRlz3r4l1zdeaPiasgEbw.zh: 非洲區自2025年初迄今年3/1,阿爾及利亞、查德、幾內亞、馬利、茅利塔亞、日、奈及利亞和南非8國共通報超過29,000 例疑病例,其中1,420例死亡(CFR:4.9%),其中 752例經實驗確定病例,主要集中於日(313例)、奈及利亞(211例)及南非(93例)。WHO評估疫情有進一步地理擴散的潛力、致死率偏高、控制疫情的資源(疫苗與DAT)嚴重不足、且監測與實驗室系統受限, 該區傳播風險為中,全球風險為低。 奈及利亞日(Niger)州疫情呈多點擴散,今年截至8月,累計報告124例確定病例,17例死亡(CFR:13.7%),高於該國同期平均(2.3%),病例主要為未接種疫苗之兒童。因疫苗覆蓋率低,以及跨區人口流動及疫苗猶豫等因素,該國刻正推動逐戶接種疫苗及與宗教領袖合作等措施,以防止疫情擴散。 塞內加爾今年5至8月進行病歷回溯調查(醫療機構病歷),有591 例曾出現喉嚨痛、扁桃腺炎等症狀,其中7例為確定病例,主要集中於東部凱杜古(Kedougou)及薩拉亞(Saraya)地區,該國已於受影響區加強疫苗補接種與主動監測,以防止疫情向周邊擴散。
KDRlz3r4l1zdeaPiasgEbw.en: From early 2025 to 1 March this year, eight countries in the African Region (Algeria, Chad, Guinea, Mali, Mauritania, Niger, Nigeria and South Africa) reported more than 29,000 suspected cases, of which 1,420 died (CFR 4.9%). 752 cases were laboratory-confirmed, mainly in Niger (313), Nigeria (211) and South Africa (93). WHO assesses that the outbreak has potential for further geographic spread and a high case fatality rate, that control resources (vaccines and diphtheria antitoxin, DAT) are severely insufficient, and that surveillance and laboratory systems are limited; the transmission risk in the region is moderate, and the global risk is low. In Niger State, Nigeria, the outbreak has spread across multiple points: as of August this year, 124 confirmed cases and 17 deaths had been cumulatively reported (CFR 13.7%), higher than the country's average for the same period (2.3%); most cases were unvaccinated children. Owing to low vaccine coverage, cross-regional population movement and vaccine hesitancy, the country is pursuing door-to-door vaccination and cooperation with religious leaders to prevent further spread. In Senegal, a retrospective review of medical records from May to August this year identified 591 cases with symptoms such as sore throat and tonsillitis, of which 7 were confirmed, mainly in the eastern Kédougou and Saraya areas. Senegal has strengthened catch-up vaccination and active surveillance in affected areas to prevent spread to surrounding areas.

JmwEDfbcs2_b3JAxwcQpDg.zh: 塞內加爾西部法蒂克區於新增 1 例確定病例,為 28 歲女性,於 2/25 出現發燒、頭痛/肌肉痛、嘔吐、出血及腦膜腦炎等症狀,病患近 15天無旅遊史,3/19 經實驗室確診,當局已啟動疫情調查及防治作業。另非洲地區今年迄今累計報告 3 例,包括塞國 2 例,烏干達報告 1 例,迄無死亡病例。
JmwEDfbcs2_b3JAxwcQpDg.en: A new confirmed case has been reported in Fatick District in western Senegal: a 28-year-old woman who developed fever, headache and muscle pain, vomiting, bleeding and meningoencephalitis symptoms on 25 February. She had no travel history in the past 15 days, and laboratory confirmation was made on 19 March. Authorities have launched outbreak investigation and control operations. In addition, the African region has reported three cases cumulatively so far this year, including two in Senegal and one in Uganda, with no deaths reported.

SRWlcsopeMe8pi7ASxrsow.zh: 義大利北部倫巴第大區報告歐洲首例H9N2流感人類感染病例,病患來自非歐洲國家且於該地感染,感染前健康狀況不佳,住院治療中。另已啟動專家小組,以利與相關國際機構進行協調,並持續監控中。 全球約90%報告H9N2病例報告自中國,另越南、印度、埃及、塞內加爾及迦納也曾報告過病例,該病毒主要透過直接接觸受感染之家禽或受污染環境傳播,人類感染症狀輕微,尚未有人際間傳播案例。
SRWlcsopeMe8pi7ASxrsow.en: Lombardy Region in northern Italy has reported Europe's first human H9N2 influenza infection. The patient came from a non-European country and was infected there; the patient was in poor health before infection and is being treated in hospital. Authorities have also activated an expert group to coordinate with relevant international agencies, and monitoring continues. Around 90% of H9N2 cases reported globally have come from China; Viet Nam, India, Egypt, Senegal and Ghana have also reported cases. The virus is transmitted mainly through direct contact with infected poultry or contaminated environments; human infections have mild symptoms, and no human-to-human transmission has been reported.

nC31mIjcCQpFvXAbq4yEag.zh: 烏干達中部克揚寬齊區於2/11新增1例確診病例,為21歲男性護理師,於1/17出現頭痛、發燒、非出血性腹瀉、嘔吐、關節痛、結膜炎、上腹部/胸痛、黃疸及鼻腔/牙齦出血等症狀,2/1經實驗室PCR確診。該國每年皆有零星確診病例,去(2025)年報告17例病例(11例確定病例),其中2例死亡。ACDC 2/18 塞內加爾東部坦巴昆達區於2/10報告1例確定病例,為7歲男童,於1/7出現發燒、頭痛、肌肉/關節痛等症狀,並於同日就醫,24日經實驗室PCR確診,病患近15天無旅遊史。另該國中部卡夫林區去(2025)年報告8例病例(2例確定病例),其中1例死亡。ACDC 2/18
nC31mIjcCQpFvXAbq4yEag.en: In Kyankwanzi District in central Uganda, one new confirmed case was reported on 11 February: a 21-year-old male nurse who developed symptoms from 17 January, including headache, fever, non-haemorrhagic diarrhoea, vomiting, joint pain, conjunctivitis, upper abdominal and chest pain, jaundice and nasal and gum bleeding, and was confirmed by laboratory PCR on 1 February. The country reports sporadic confirmed cases every year; last year (2025), 17 cases were reported (11 confirmed), including 2 deaths (Africa CDC, 18 February). In Tambacounda District in eastern Senegal, one confirmed case was reported on 10 February: a 7-year-old boy who developed fever, headache and muscle and joint pain on 7 January, sought medical care the same day, and was confirmed by laboratory PCR on 24 January; the patient had no travel history in the past 15 days. In Kaffrine District in central Senegal, 8 cases (2 confirmed) were reported last year, including 1 death (Africa CDC, 18 February).

ey-aEDjotSBWGWAVyB_WNg.zh: 全球疫情更新,2025年截至12/10共41國/地區累計報告502,264例病例(208,335例確診)及186例死亡,WHO表示季節期間多個區域爆發廣泛疫情,包括先前傳播率較低或無傳播之地區,評估全球傳播風險為中。各區署疫情如下:  美洲區病例為多,該區共16國累計報告291,451例病例(110,039例確診)及141例死亡,以巴西報告243,915例病例及116例死亡為多;  東南亞區累計報告115,985例病例(7,097例確診),主要分布於印度及泰國,其中印度截至8/31累計報告108,379例疑病例及4,995例確診病例; 歐洲區累計56,986例確診病例及43例死亡,其中法國及義大利報告本土病例,另法屬留旺島累計54,555例確診病例及43例死亡,法屬馬約特島累計報告1,259例本土病例; 西太平洋區共11國/地區累計34,035例確診病例及2例死亡,其中中國累計29,497例本土確診病例,主要分布於該國廣東省25,826例; 非洲區累計報告2,211例病例(111例確診),以模里西斯共和國報告1,583例病例為多,葛摩、肯亞、塞內加爾亦報告病例; 東地中海區累計報告1,596例病例(67例確診),其中巴基斯坦及索馬利亞報告病例。
ey-aEDjotSBWGWAVyB_WNg.en: Global outbreak update: in 2025, as of 10 December, 41 countries and areas had reported 502,264 cases cumulatively (208,335 confirmed) and 186 deaths. WHO said widespread outbreaks occurred during the season in several regions, including areas where transmission had previously been low or absent, and assessed the global transmission risk as moderate. Regional situation: the Region of the Americas reported the most cases. Sixteen countries reported 291,451 cases cumulatively (110,039 confirmed) and 141 deaths, mainly Brazil with 243,915 cases and 116 deaths. The South-East Asia Region reported 115,985 cases cumulatively (7,097 confirmed), mainly in India and Thailand; India reported 108,379 suspected and 4,995 confirmed cases as of 31 August. The European Region reported 56,986 confirmed cases and 43 deaths cumulatively. France and Italy reported local cases. Separately, French Réunion reported 54,555 confirmed cases and 43 deaths cumulatively, and French Mayotte reported 1,259 local cases cumulatively. The Western Pacific Region reported 34,035 confirmed cases and 2 deaths cumulatively across 11 countries and areas; China reported 29,497 local confirmed cases, mainly 25,826 in Guangdong province. The African Region reported 2,211 cases cumulatively (111 confirmed), mainly 1,583 cases in the Republic of Mauritius; the Comoros, Kenya and Senegal also reported cases. The Eastern Mediterranean Region reported 1,596 cases cumulatively (67 confirmed), with Pakistan and Somalia reporting cases.

240fN1vrIfZyIfTX_nW6AA.zh: 茅利塔亞今年迄今共14個地區累計報告286例病例(53例確診)及15例死亡,確診病例以男性為多(77%),年齡分布以大於15歲為主(96%)。 塞內加爾疫情更新,於今年9月爆發疫情,最初病例主要分布於聖路易、盧加及馬塔姆區,迄今累計546例確診病例及31例死亡,病例蔓延至聖路易區(367例)、馬塔姆/法蒂克區(39例)、考拉克區(35例)等地,近期每週新增病例數及死亡數呈下降趨勢。
240fN1vrIfZyIfTX_nW6AA.en: Mauritania has reported 286 cases this year to date across 14 regions (53 confirmed), including 15 deaths. Among confirmed cases, males predominate (77%), and most cases are aged over 15 (96%). Senegal update: the outbreak began in September this year, with the first cases mainly in Saint-Louis, Louga and Matam regions. To date, 546 confirmed cases and 31 deaths have been reported cumulatively. Cases have spread to Saint-Louis region (367), Matam/Fatick region (39) and Kaolack region (35). Weekly numbers of new cases and deaths have shown a declining trend recently.

RwiH5S7iW4R5BzeFENWF6w.zh: 塞內加爾疫情更新,自今年9月爆發疫情以來截至12/3共11個地區累計536例確診病例及31例死亡,病例主要分布於該國西北部聖路易區365例,70%病例之職業會暴露於受感染動物或遭受蚊子叮咬。大多數人類病例症狀輕微,惟少部分患者發展成嚴重疾病,另有超過2,000例動物病例或流產,當局已加強動物疫苗接種措施。
RwiH5S7iW4R5BzeFENWF6w.en: Senegal update: since the outbreak began in September this year, 536 confirmed cases and 31 deaths have been reported across 11 regions as of 3 December. Cases are mainly in Saint-Louis region in the northwest (365). 70% of cases had occupational exposure to infected animals or mosquito bites. Most human cases have mild symptoms, while a small number develop severe disease. More than 2,000 animal cases or abortions have also been reported, and authorities have strengthened animal vaccination.

5Rxj2zadgrZe1wCmYRSI5w.zh: 塞內加爾疫情更新,自9月疫情爆發迄今累計381例病例(312例已康復)及29例死亡(致死率7.6%),分布於該國9個地區,病例數以該國西北部聖路易區294例為多。 茅利塔亞疫情更新,今年迄今累計176例病例(42例確診)及14例死亡(致死率7.95%),分布於該國11個地區。
5Rxj2zadgrZe1wCmYRSI5w.en: Senegal update: Since the outbreak began in September, 381 cases (312 recovered) and 29 deaths (case fatality rate 7.6%) have been reported cumulatively, distributed across nine regions of the country. Of these, 294 cases were in the Saint-Louis region in the north-west. Mauritania update: This year to date, 176 cases (42 confirmed) and 14 deaths (case fatality rate 7.95%) have been reported cumulatively, distributed across 11 regions of the country.

ahy2hFD7J-RfgVFwsq7gIw.zh: 塞內加爾自9月爆發疫情迄今累計245例病例,其中21例死亡,病患主要分布於西北部聖路易區,當局已與動物部門合作並啟動牲畜疫苗接種作業及民眾宣導等防治措施。
ahy2hFD7J-RfgVFwsq7gIw.en: Since the outbreak began in September, Senegal has reported 245 cumulative cases, of which 21 died. Cases are mainly distributed in the north-western Saint-Louis region. Authorities, in cooperation with the animal health sector, have launched livestock vaccination and public awareness measures.

tjA_q2iHEzNpZ9ArJes9Ow.zh: 茅利塔亞南部地區今年報告74例疑病例,其中7例死亡(CFR:9.5%),病例較去年同期下降33%,病患主要為15歲以下族群,顯示兒童常規疫苗接種出現免疫缺口,當地已組織應變小組並持續進行流行病學監測,由於該國南部邊境鄰近馬利/塞內加爾,跨境人口流動頻繁,且醫療資源匱乏,使當地易發生跨國傳播。
tjA_q2iHEzNpZ9ArJes9Ow.en: In southern Mauritania, 74 suspected cases were reported this year, of which 7 died (CFR 9.5%). Cases are 33% lower than in the same period last year, and most patients are under 15 years old, indicating immunization gaps in routine childhood vaccination. A local response team has been organized and epidemiological surveillance continues. Because the southern border is close to Mali and Senegal, cross-border population movement is frequent and medical resources are scarce, the area is prone to cross-border transmission.

q02iJuGx7Mri6EKxyM1-4w.zh: 本月更新:  全球自2022年5月截至今年9/26累計141國/地區報告16萬2千餘例確診病例,其中,至少430例死亡(CFR:0.2%)。 全球今年截至第39週累計96國/地區報告4萬2千餘例確診病例,其中非洲區3萬5,363例、美洲區3,314例、歐洲區2,044例、西太平洋區1,229例、東南亞區95例及東地中海區40例。東地中海與歐洲疫情上升,非洲、美洲、西太平洋、東南亞疫情下降。  其他更新:  美國加州9/15報告新增1例I型病例,為該州第2例、該國第6例I型病例,病患近期具中東旅遊史,與其他病例無流行病學關聯。*加州首例為2024年11月報告。 塞內加爾自今年8月報告首例截至9/23累計4例病例,首例為境外移入Ib型病例,案2確診IIb型,與案1無流行病學關聯,案3、4為案2接觸者,推測感染為IIb型病例,當局已匡列40名接觸者。 愛爾蘭9/18報告3例Ib型確診病例及1例疑病例,首例確診病例與具中東旅遊史之疑病例具流行病關聯,餘2例確診者為首例之密切接觸者,其中有1名兒童,目前病患皆已康復。當局評估該國風險仍低,並呼籲旅外民眾應採取必要公衛措施。 科威特8/10報告該國首例M痘病例,為IIb型,迄今累計3例確診病例,首例具中國旅遊史,當局已疫調並匡列接觸者。 澳大利亞9/9報告新增1例Ib型病例,具中國及菲律賓旅遊史,為該國自2024年1月迄今第3例,當局已疫調並追蹤接觸者,並協助接種暴露後疫苗。 泰國9/9報告新增Ib型病例,病患為成年男性,具阿曼旅遊史。為該國自2024年1月迄今第6例Ib型病例。  評估與建議: WHO於9/5公布經IHR緊急委員會第5次會議討論,建議中止國際關注公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC),WHO於記者會表示,剛果民主共和國/蒲隆地/獅子山/烏干達等國病例/死亡數持續下降,且對疾病傳播及嚴重度風險因素已逐漸掌握,受影響國家亦建立持續應對能力,不再構成PHEIC,惟提醒PHEIC解除並不代表威脅已經消失,非洲CDC仍持續列為非洲緊急衛生事件。WHO評估全球公共衛生風險為中等,由於不同基因型持續流行、監測及診斷能力不足、資金缺乏及社區參與需更多資源,WHO已將長期建議延長至2026年8月。
q02iJuGx7Mri6EKxyM1-4w.en: Monthly update: Since May 2022 and as of 26 September this year, 141 countries and areas have reported more than 162,000 confirmed cases, of which at least 430 died (CFR 0.2%). Year to date as of week 39, 96 countries and areas have reported more than 42,000 confirmed cases: 35,363 in the African Region, 3,314 in the Region of the Americas, 2,044 in the European Region, 1,229 in the Western Pacific Region, 95 in the South-East Asia Region and 40 in the Eastern Mediterranean Region. Cases have risen in the Eastern Mediterranean and Europe and declined in Africa, the Americas, the Western Pacific and South-East Asia. Other updates: On 15 September, California, United States, reported one new clade I case, the state's second and the country's sixth clade I case. The patient had recent travel history to the Middle East and no epidemiological link to other cases. The state's first case was reported in November 2024. Senegal reported its first case in August this year; as of 23 September, a cumulative 4 cases had been reported. The first case was an imported clade Ib case. Case 2 was confirmed as clade IIb and had no epidemiological link to case 1; cases 3 and 4 were contacts of case 2, and their infection is presumed to be clade IIb. Authorities have identified 40 contacts. Ireland reported three confirmed clade Ib cases and one suspected case on 18 September. The first confirmed case was epidemiologically linked to a suspected case with travel history to the Middle East; the other two confirmed cases were close contacts of the first, one of whom was a child. All patients have recovered. Authorities assess the country's risk as still low and urge travellers abroad to take necessary public health measures. Kuwait reported its first mpox case on 10 August; it was clade IIb, and 3 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively. The first case had travel history to China, and authorities have conducted an investigation and identified contacts. Australia reported one new clade Ib case on 9 September, with travel history to China and the Philippines; it is the country's third case since January 2024. Authorities have investigated and followed up contacts, and have helped administer post-exposure vaccines. Thailand reported a new clade Ib case on 9 September; the patient is an adult man with travel history to Oman, and it is the country's sixth clade Ib case since January 2024. Assessment and recommendations: On 5 September, WHO, following the fifth meeting of the IHR Emergency Committee, recommended ending the Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). At a press conference, WHO said case and death numbers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Burundi, Sierra Leone and Uganda continue to decline, risk factors for transmission and severity are increasingly understood, and affected countries have established sustained response capacity, so the event no longer constitutes a PHEIC. WHO cautioned that ending the PHEIC does not mean the threat has disappeared, and Africa CDC continues to treat the event as an emergency health event in Africa. WHO assesses the global public health risk as moderate. Because different genotypes continue to circulate, surveillance and diagnostic capacity are insufficient, funding is lacking, and community engagement requires more resources, WHO has extended its long-term recommendations to August 2026.

diSFX6Cg4zSRe5XKFKv5rw.en: Global influenza activity is at a low level, with influenza A the main circulating type. The Northern Hemisphere as a whole remains low and stable. Test positivity rose slightly in Central America, the Caribbean, West Africa, East Africa, South Asia and South-East Asia; positivity exceeded 30% in Bangladesh, the Maldives and Senegal; activity rose slightly in tropical South America, northern Europe and South-East Asia. Most countries in the Southern Hemisphere remain stable, but test positivity in South-East Asia and Oceania is slightly higher (10%). By subtype, H1N1 predominates in Central America, West Africa and Oceania; H3N2 predominates in South Asia and South-East Asia; in East Africa, influenza A and B detections are similar in proportion.

nBqEEVuHsXy7SfhbWajFEQ.en: In Kaffrine region, central Senegal, two confirmed cases were reported on 13 January, one of whom died. The index case is a 45-year-old rural man who developed fever, fatigue, joint pain and vomiting of blood on 2 January. He received outpatient treatment on 4–5 January and went home; on 7 January his condition worsened and he was taken to a medical centre, where samples were collected. He died on 8 January, and was confirmed after death. Case 2 is a 65-year-old man, a contact of case 1, who attended the same medical centre; after developing similar symptoms he was sampled and confirmed, and has now recovered and been discharged. Bovine serum and tick samples near the index case's home tested positive. As of 24 January, 28 contacts have completed follow-up, and 23 remain under follow-up. The country's most recent previous outbreak was in November 2024.
